question: Find $x$ and $y$ if $$A=\begin{bmatrix}2 & x+1 & 3 \\ 5 & 1 & y \\ 3 & -2 & 4\end{bmatrix}$$ is a symmetric matrix.
explanation:
Symmetry condition
For a symmetric matrix, corresponding entries on opposite sides of the diagonal are equal.
Comparison of corresponding entries
From $a_{12}=a_{21}$, $$x+1=5\Rightarrow x=4$$
From $a_{23}=a_{32}$, $$y=-2$$
The entries $a_{13}$ and $a_{31}$ are already equal since both are $3$.
Required values
$$x=4,\quad y=-2$$
